FRENZIED_THREE_FINGERS_POWER.title: 狂える三本指
FRENZIED_THREE_FINGERS_POWER.description: 自分の召喚物すべてがHPを失うたび、その値と同量のダメージをランダムな敵1体に与える。
FIGHT_FOR_ME_POWER.title: 私のために戦って
FIGHT_FOR_ME_POWER.description: ターン開始時、[gold]召喚[/gold]する。
LIGHT_SPIRIT_POWER.title: 光の精霊
LIGHT_SPIRIT_POWER.description: 各ターン最初にカードを[gold]回収[/gold]したとき、{Amount}{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}を得る。
HEAVY_ECHO_POWER.title: 重き残響
HEAVY_ECHO_POWER.description: 完全に[gold]チャージ[/gold]されたカードをプレイした後、[gold]召喚[/gold]する。
CHANTING_BLESSING_POWER.title: 詠唱の祝福
CHANTING_BLESSING_POWER.description: [gold]チャージ[/gold]した後、{Amount}[gold]ブロック[/gold]を得る。
FOLLOWING_SHADOW_POWER.title: 付き従う影
FOLLOWING_SHADOW_POWER.description: 各ターン最初に[gold]ヘレン[/gold]を[gold]召喚[/gold]したとき、カードを1枚引き、1{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}を得る。
NECROMANCY_POWER.title: 死霊術
NECROMANCY_POWER.description: 毎ターン終了時にHPを4失う。
NECRO_ATTACK_POWER.title: 攻撃
NECRO_ATTACK_POWER.description: 復讐者のターン開始時、ランダムな敵1体に{Damage}ダメージを{Hits}回与える。
NECRO_PROTECT_POWER.title: 守護
NECRO_PROTECT_POWER.description:
復讐者のターン開始時、ランダムな敵1体に{Damage}ダメージを与える。
与えたダメージに等しい[gold]ブロック[/gold]を復讐者に与える。
MUTUAL_UNDERSTANDING_POWER.title: 以心伝心
MUTUAL_UNDERSTANDING_POWER.description: [gold]家族[/gold]を交代した後、[gold]家族[/gold]が[gold]筋力[/gold]{Amount}を得る。
CHANGE_HANDS_POWER.title: 交代
CHANGE_HANDS_POWER.description: [gold]フレデリック[/gold]が登場したとき、[gold]共鳴[/gold]する。
RELAY_POWER.title: 連携
RELAY_POWER.description: [gold]家族[/gold]を交代した後、[gold]共鳴[/gold]する。
PACK_UP_POWER.title: 荷造り
PACK_UP_POWER.description: [gold]ヘレン[/gold]が離脱したとき、[gold]山札[/gold]から最大{Amount}枚を選んで捨てる。
GHOSTLY_TOUCH_POWER.title: 幽玄の触れ
GHOSTLY_TOUCH_POWER.description: 召喚物が行動した後、ランダムな敵1体に[gold]凍傷[/gold]{Amount}を付与する。
DUCHESS_MOMENT_DESCRIPTION_POWER.title: 時刻
DUCHESS_MOMENT_DESCRIPTION_POWER.descrip:
各ターン開始時、時刻を0に戻す。
カードをプレイするたび、時刻が1増加する。
指定された時刻にカードをプレイすると、時刻効果が発動する。
時刻12の次は時刻0に戻る。
DUCHESS_REACTION_DESCRIPTION_POWER.title: リアクション
DUCHESS_REACTION_DESCRIPTION_POWER.descr: リアクション：毎ターンの通常の初手ドロー以外でこのカードを引いた時、次にプレイするまでコストが1減る。
DUCHESS_MOMENT_POWER.title: 時刻
DUCHESS_MOMENT_POWER.description: 現在の時刻を記録する。
DUCHESS_REACTION_BLOCK_POWER.title: 平静
DUCHESS_REACTION_BLOCK_POWER.description: [gold]リアクション[/gold]のカードをプレイするたび、[gold]ブロック[/gold]{Amount}を得る。
DUCHESS_MOMENT_FIVE_DRAW_POWER.title: 秘めた拍子
DUCHESS_MOMENT_FIVE_DRAW_POWER.descripti: [gold]時刻[/gold]が5に到達するたび、カードを{Amount}枚引く。
DUCHESS_DODGE_MOMENT_POWER.title: 密かな決意
DUCHESS_DODGE_MOMENT_POWER.description: [gold]回避[/gold]をプレイするたび、[gold]時刻[/gold]を追加で{Amount}進める。
DUCHESS_SHUFFLE_BLOCK_POWER.title: 崩れぬ余裕
DUCHESS_SHUFFLE_BLOCK_POWER.description: 手札か捨て札からカードを山札に加えてシャッフルするたび、[gold]ブロック[/gold]{Amount}を得る。
DUCHESS_REACTION_DRAW_POWER.title: 稲妻の神経
DUCHESS_REACTION_DRAW_POWER.description: 自分のターン中に[gold]リアクション[/gold]のカードを引くたび、追加で{Amount}枚引く。
DUCHESS_END_TURN_MOMENT_BLOCK_POWER.desc: ターン終了時、1スタックごとに現在の[gold]時刻[/gold]に等しい[gold]ブロック[/gold]を得る。
DUCHESS_TURN_START_SWAP_POWER.title: すり替え
DUCHESS_TURN_START_SWAP_POWER.descriptio: 毎ターン開始時、手札から1枚選んで山札に加えてシャッフルし、カードを1枚引く。
DUCHESS_TEMPORARY_STRENGTH_DOWN_POWER.de: ターン終了時、同量の筋力を失う。
DUCHESS_CONCEALMENT_POWER.title: 隠密
DUCHESS_CONCEALMENT_POWER.description: アタックのダメージとカードから得るブロックが25%増える。ターン終了時、隠密を1失う。
DUCHESS_REACTION_DRAW_BLOCK_POWER.title: 平静
DUCHESS_REACTION_DRAW_BLOCK_POWER.descri: 自分のターン中にリアクションのカードを引くたび、ブロックを{Amount}得る。
DUCHESS_RADIANT_BLADE_GROWTH_POWER.title: 輝剣の魔術
DUCHESS_RADIANT_BLADE_GROWTH_POWER.descr: 輝剣をプレイするたび、この戦闘中すべての輝剣のダメージが{Amount}増える。
DUCHESS_FULL_BLOCK_RADIANT_BLADE_POWER.d: このターン初めて攻撃全体を完全に防いだとき、輝剣を{Amount}枚手札に加える。
DUCHESS_END_TURN_DODGE_POWER.title: 冷静沈着
DUCHESS_END_TURN_DODGE_POWER.description: ターン終了時、回避を{Amount}枚山札に加えてシャッフルする。
DUCHESS_END_TURN_RETAIN_POWER.title: 襟を整える
DUCHESS_END_TURN_RETAIN_POWER.descriptio: このターン終了時、手札から最大{Amount}枚保留する。
DUCHESS_BEAT_POWER.title: 拍子
DUCHESS_BEAT_POWER.description: 時刻が6に到達するたび、エナジーを{Amount}得る。
DUCHESS_MOMENT_FIVE_BLOCK_POWER.title: 黄金の時刻
DUCHESS_MOMENT_FIVE_BLOCK_POWER.descript: 時刻が3に到達したとき、ブロックを{Amount}得る。
DUCHESS_ETERNAL_RESTAGE_POWER.title: 終わらぬリステージ
DUCHESS_ETERNAL_RESTAGE_POWER.descriptio: 時刻12に到達したときターンを終了する。ターン終了時、このターン与えたダメージ3につき敵全体に1ダメージを与える。 NL このターン終了時のダメージ：{PendingDamage}。
DUCHESS_REPLAY_MOMENT_THREE_POWER.title: 完璧な予行
DUCHESS_REPLAY_MOMENT_THREE_POWER.descri: このターン時刻3でプレイしたカードはリプレイする。
DUCHESS_ETERNAL_FORM_POWER.title: 永遠の姿
DUCHESS_ETERNAL_FORM_POWER.description: カードの時刻効果を発動するたび、エナジーを{Amount}得る。
DUCHESS_SHADOW_SWORD_POWER.title: 影の剣
DUCHESS_SHADOW_SWORD_POWER.description: 隠密中、筋力を{Amount}得る。隠密が終了するとその筋力を失う。
DUCHESS_ZERO_COST_ATTACK_POWER.title: 寸短寸利
DUCHESS_ZERO_COST_ATTACK_POWER.descripti: コスト0のアタックはダメージが{Amount}増加する。
DUCHESS_GRACEFUL_SWORD_DANCE_POWER.title: 優雅な剣舞
DUCHESS_GRACEFUL_SWORD_DANCE_POWER.descr: 回避を連続してプレイしたとき、敵全体に{Amount}ダメージを与える。
DUCHESS_PHANTOM_KILLER_POWER.title: 幻影の殺意
DUCHESS_PHANTOM_KILLER_POWER.description: この戦闘中に[gold]隠密[/gold]状態で[gold]リーサル[/gold]を発動したなら、次の戦闘開始時に[gold]筋力[/gold]を{Amount}得る。
WYLDER_PURSUIT_POWER.title: Pursuit
WYLDER_PURSUIT_POWER.description:
When you play an Attack, its attack damage is increased by 50%.
When you play a Skill, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card.
WYLDER_BREAK_DESCRIPTION_POWER.title: Break
WYLDER_BREAK_DESCRIPTION_POWER.descripti: When this card's attack damage reaches the requirement, trigger its additional [gold]Break[/gold] effect.
WYLDER_CORPSE_WAX_POWER.title: Corpse Wax
WYLDER_CORPSE_WAX_POWER.description:
At the end of the enemy turn, lose {Amount} HP.
Each application of [gold]Corpse Wax[/gold] lasts for 2 enemy turns independently.
This ignores [gold]Block[/gold] and is not attack damage.
WYLDER_EMBER_RESERVE_POWER.title: Ember Reserve
WYLDER_EMBER_RESERVE_POWER.description:
The first real attack consumption of Vigor counts even before deployment.
Block is granted after the whole card resolves.
WYLDER_CLASH_EMBERS_POWER.title: Clash Embers
WYLDER_CLASH_EMBERS_POWER.description:
The first Attack claims eligibility when it begins, even if it misses.
Deploying later does not grant the reward retroactively; Vigor is gained after the whole card.
WYLDER_OPENING_HUNT_POWER.title: Opening Hunt
WYLDER_OPENING_HUNT_POWER.description:
The first successful Break counts even before deployment.
A killing blow still qualifies; rewards follow the whole attack and its own effects, with 2 Vigor per upgraded copy.
WYLDER_WINDWARD_STANCE_POWER.title: Windward Stance
WYLDER_WINDWARD_STANCE_POWER.description:
Eligibility begins when this Power is deployed.
Reentry qualifies; Block follows card effects and the old Pursuit draw.
WYLDER_BATTLE_INSTINCT_POWER.title: Battle Instinct
WYLDER_BATTLE_INSTINCT_POWER.description:
Only Attacks actually played from hand qualify, including hand autoplay but not external replays.
Check for the single Skill after all related draws; failed conditions do not spend eligibility.
WYLDER_BLOOD_STILL_HOT_POWER.title: Blood Still Hot
WYLDER_BLOOD_STILL_HOT_POWER.description:
The first actual Vigor gain counts card and Power sources, including gains before deployment.
Enemy-turn gains do not count; rewards inside attacks wait until the whole card finishes.
WYLDER_FLAME_GUARD_STANCE_POWER.title: Flame Guard Stance
WYLDER_FLAME_GUARD_STANCE_POWER.descript:
Only Vigor actually consumed by the native attack counts, not direct Skill losses.
New Pursuit is granted after the whole card and cannot enhance its remaining hits.
WYLDER_PURSUIT_COMMAND_POWER.title: Pursuit Command
WYLDER_PURSUIT_COMMAND_POWER.description:
Only a card's direct entry or reentry into Pursuit counts, not Powers or Relics.
The first such entry counts even before deployment; all copies together draw at most 2 cards per turn.
WYLDER_BATTLEFIELD_MIGHT_POWER.title: Battlefield Might
WYLDER_BATTLEFIELD_MIGHT_POWER.descripti:
The first successful Break counts across the whole turn; kills still reward.
Strength is granted after the whole attack and cannot boost its remaining hits.
WYLDER_GUARD_RESURGENCE_POWER.title: Guard Resurgence
WYLDER_GUARD_RESURGENCE_POWER.descriptio:
Only a Skill's successful Stun qualifies, including Parry autoplayed from hand.
The reward snapshots copies at trigger time and is paid after next turn's base resources initialize.
WYLDER_SWIFT_BATTLE_WILL_POWER.title: Swift Battle Will
WYLDER_SWIFT_BATTLE_WILL_POWER.descripti:
The first qualifying settlement counts even before deployment.
Every Swift Battle Will card and every external replay is excluded.
The check occurs after all Pursuit and related Power draws.
WYLDER_RUINOUS_GHOSTFLAME_POWER.title: Ruinous Ghostflame
WYLDER_RUINOUS_GHOSTFLAME_POWER.descript:
Whenever an attack hit deals more than 20 damage to an enemy, apply 2 [gold]Freeze[/gold] (3 when upgraded).
Check each hit separately before Block.
WYLDER_PURSUIT_STANCE_POWER.title: Pursuit Stance
WYLDER_PURSUIT_STANCE_POWER.description:
Consumes the old Pursuit eligibility even if the status instance survives reentry.
Power cards spend the first-consumption opportunity without an Attack or Skill reward.
All copies grant at most 1 Energy or 20 base Block, with Dexterity applied once.
WYLDER_FIERY_BLOOD_POWER.title: Fiery Blood
WYLDER_FIERY_BLOOD_POWER.description:
Only actual Vigor gained directly by a card counts.
Eligibility is locked before this Power's extra gain; indirect Power gains cannot trigger it recursively.
WYLDER_VETERAN_EDGE_POWER.title: Veteran Edge
WYLDER_VETERAN_EDGE_POWER.description: Whenever you trigger [gold]Break[/gold], gain 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] per stack.
WYLDER_UNYIELDING_SPIRIT_POWER.title: Unyielding Spirit
WYLDER_UNYIELDING_SPIRIT_POWER.descripti:
Resets at the start of each player turn.
Block is granted immediately after the first enemy hit that causes HP loss, protecting later hits but not undoing damage already taken.
WYLDER_NIGHT_EDGE_POWER.title: Night Edge
WYLDER_NIGHT_EDGE_POWER.description:
The first Attack with Break counts across the turn, including autoplay, replay and attacks before deployment; failure still spends its threshold reduction.
The first successful Break is independent and awards Vigor after the whole card.
Use the strongest threshold reduction and Vigor reward across copies, not their sum.
WYLDER_BOLDNESS_POWER.title: Boldness
WYLDER_BOLDNESS_POWER.description: When an attack hit deals more than 20 damage before Block, gain 5 Block (7 when upgraded).
WYLDER_NIGHT_FORM_POWER.title: Night Form
WYLDER_NIGHT_FORM_POWER.description:
Double the effects of [gold]Pursuit[/gold].
Pursuit grants 100% bonus attack damage, or 2 Energy and 2 cards when you play a Skill.
WYLDER_REMAINING_EMBER_POWER.title: Remaining Ember
WYLDER_REMAINING_EMBER_POWER.description: Whenever you enter [gold]Pursuit[/gold], add 1 [gold]Fire Coating[/gold] to your hand per stack (upgraded stacks add [gold]Fire Coating+[/gold]).
WYLDER_UNDYING_POWER.title: Undying
WYLDER_UNDYING_POWER.description: When [gold]Vigor[/gold] triggers, keep half its stacks.
WYLDER_ERUPTION_POWER.title: Eruption
WYLDER_ERUPTION_POWER.description: Whenever you trigger [gold]Break[/gold], deal 7 damage to ALL enemies (9 when upgraded).
WYLDER_WILDFIRE_POWER.title: Spreading Wildfire
WYLDER_WILDFIRE_POWER.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Vigor[/gold], deal damage equal to the stacks gained to a random enemy.
WYLDER_MARTIAL_MASTERY_POWER.title: Martial Mastery
WYLDER_MARTIAL_MASTERY_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, choose 1 of 3 random Attacks from your draw pile and add it to your hand per stack.
WYLDER_LIFE_FROM_DEATH_POWER.title: Life from Death
WYLDER_MULTIPLAYER_POWER.title: Wylder
WYLDER_MULTIPLAYER_POWER.description:
Whenever you trigger [gold]Break[/gold], add {Amount} [gold]Fire Coating[/gold] cards to each other player's hand.
Upgraded copies generate [gold]Fire Coating+[/gold].
WYLDER_OFFENSIVE_INSTINCT_POWER.title: Offensive Instinct
WYLDER_OFFENSIVE_INSTINCT_POWER.descript: Whenever you enter [gold]Pursuit[/gold], apply 1 Vulnerable to a random enemy {Amount} times.
WYLDER_HEROES_ASSEMBLE_POWER.title: Heroes Assemble
WYLDER_HEROES_ASSEMBLE_POWER.description: At the start of your next turn, ALL players enter [gold]Pursuit[/gold].
WYLDER_MURDEROUS_AURA_POWER.title: Murderous Aura
WYLDER_MURDEROUS_AURA_POWER.description:
At the start of your turn, draw {Amount} fewer cards.
Gain {StatGain} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {StatGain} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
WYLDER_FORGET_THE_SWORD_POWER.title: Forget the Sword
WYLDER_FORGET_THE_SWORD_POWER.descriptio: While you have 3 or fewer cards in hand, deal {Amount}% more attack damage.
WYLDER_ENDLESS_WILL_POWER.title: Endless Will
WYLDER_ENDLESS_WILL_POWER.description: Whenever an enemy is Stunned, enter [gold]Pursuit[/gold].
WYLDER_SHRIEK_OF_MILOS_POWER.title: Shriek of Milos
WYLDER_SHRIEK_OF_MILOS_POWER.description: Your next {Amount} Attacks deal double damage.
WYLDER_SEAMLESS_POWER.title: Seamless
WYLDER_SEAMLESS_POWER.description: Whenever you play the last card in your hand, gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold].
WYLDER_MOONLIGHT_SWORD_POWER.title: Moonlight Sword
WYLDER_MOONLIGHT_SWORD_POWER.description:
Whenever you enter [gold]Pursuit[/gold], apply 2 [gold]Freeze[/gold] to a random enemy {Amount} times.
Upgraded copies apply 3 instead.
